'''Jell Spiel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] who served the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] as a [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud car]] pilot during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWI" /> He co-piloted one of two [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud cars]] near [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] when the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] arrived there. One Cloud Car fired warning shots at the freighter before escorting it to a landing platform.<ref name="TESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> Spiel's experience as a pilot of cloud car prototypes proved very useful during the evacuation of Bespin.<ref name="SWI" />

==Behind the scenes==
This character was most prominently seen as an action figure in [[Kenner Products|Kenner's]] [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (toy line)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' toy line]]<ref name="KennerCCP">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (toy line)|pack=(Twin Pod) Cloud Car Pilot|link=VINtCloudcarpilot.asp}}</ref>, though the pilots can be briefly glimpsed inside the Cloud Cars in the film. Close up photos of the Cloud Car prop used in the film shows two different pilots inside the pods.<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref><ref name="SVC24">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 24|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 24]]</ref> The action figure package photo appears to be one of those pilots.<ref name="KennerCCP" /> His name and personal history was finally revealed in the [[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]] feature of [[Star Wars Insider 148|''Star Wars Insider'' 148]].<ref name="SWI" /> The second pilot, distinguished by a mustache,<ref name="SWTC">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/swtc/exhibit/cloudcar.html|text=Photos from ''Star Wars: The Magic of Myth'' exhibit|work=TheForce.net|archivedate=20061005171214}}</ref> was the basis for a later action figure by [[Hasbro]].<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|pack=#011: (Twin Pod) Cloud Car Pilot|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Twin_Pod_Cloud_Car_Pilot_Vintage_Collection_TVC_VC11.asp}}</ref> He was later named [[Duncan Hikmat]].<ref name="SWI" />

The figures' full uniforms were based on concept art by [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]], which was later used to represent [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] officer [[Kem Monnon/Legends|Kem Monnon]] in ''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''.<ref name="Illustrated">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>
